install_tell: kopia server start --address 0.0.0.0:51515 --without-password --insecure  (auth-OFF mode; default legacy `kopia server` is auth-ON)
misconfig_patterns: kopia server started with --without-password --insecure returns a real 200 sources/snapshots body unauthenticated; the legacy default (no flag) is auth-ON and returns 401 "Missing credentials." / "Invalid or missing CSRF token."

AI-scope discriminator: the in-scope gate is the snapshot SOURCE PATH, not the server. GET /api/v1/sources returns sources[] where each source.path (names only) is in-scope when it targets AI/ML data: MLflow artifact stores (/mlruns, mlflow/artifacts, mlartifacts/), HuggingFace caches (~/.cache/huggingface, hub/models--*), model checkpoints (*.ckpt, *.safetensors, *.gguf, checkpoints/, models/), vector-DB data dirs (.../chroma, qdrant/storage, milvus, weaviate, lancedb, *.faiss), or dataset roots (datasets/, *.parquet corpora, .dvc). A server whose only sources are /home, /etc, Docker volumes, or generic DB dumps is plain substrate, OUT of scope.

Restraint: names and metadata only. The in-scope finding is an unauth Kopia server whose snapshot SOURCE PATHS point at AI/ML data — that source-path list IS the finding. Do NOT call GET /api/v1/objects/{objectID} or mount/restore endpoints (reading a snapshot tree/object = exfiltration). Do NOT POST to /api/v1/restore, /api/v1/mounts, /api/v1/repo/connect, /api/v1/repo/create, or /api/v1/repo/exists — restore/mount are write/read-out primitives and /api/v1/repo/exists is the CVE-2026-45695 RCE sink. Enumerate the catalog, never the cargo.

response_markers: JSON body of GET /api/v1/sources contains the exact field quartet: "localUsername", "localHost", "multiUser", and a "sources" array
Each /api/v1/sources element has SourceStatus fields "source","status","schedule","lastSnapshot","nextSnapshotTime","upload","currentTask" (vendor-unique combination)

GET /api/v1/repo/status StatusResponse fields: "connected","configFile","formatVersion","hash","encryption","ecc","splitter","maxPackSize","storage" (hash/encryption/splitter trio is Kopia-format-unique)
Web UI: HTML title / React bundle branded "KopiaUI"; default self-signed TLS cert on :51515
Unauthenticated request to a protected route returns body "Missing credentials."; with creds but no token returns "Invalid or missing CSRF token."
active_probe.false_positive_check: Require the EXACT field quartet localUsername+localHost+multiUser+sources AND a well-formed SourceStatus element, not just the substring "sources". A catch-all that 200s every path is the negative guard. Broad "backup" dorks pull in Restic REST server, Bacula, UrBackup, Duplicati, BorgBackup UIs — exclude by requiring the SourcesResponse JSON field names, which none of those emit. Port 51515 is not IANA-reserved for Kopia; confirm with the /api/v1/repo/status hash+encryption+splitter trio. Drop-in UIs (joachimdalen/kopia-alternate-ui) proxy the same API — fingerprint the API JSON, not the HTML chrome. 401 "Missing credentials."/"Invalid or missing CSRF token." = surface open, access NOT exercised; do NOT label unauth. The load-bearing read is a 200-with-data on /api/v1/sources returning a populated sources[] array.

deployment_tells: GET /api/v1/repo/status exposes the Kopia-format-unique hash/encryption/splitter trio
Web UI / React bundle branded KopiaUI on :51515 behind a default self-signed TLS cert
pivot_paths: GET /api/v1/repo/status -> read repo format metadata (storage backend type, hash/encryption/splitter, formatVersion) to confirm a live Kopia repo, names/config only
GET /api/v1/sources -> enumerate every backup source: list the source[].path values to apply the AI-scope discriminator (which paths are MLflow/vector-DB/model/dataset dirs)

GET /api/v1/snapshots?userName=&host=&path=

-> list snapshot manifests (timestamps, sizes, root object IDs) for an in-scope source; metadata only, never resolve the root
GET /api/v1/cli and GET /api/v1/current-user -> confirm passwordless/anonymous mode and server identity
GET /api/v1/tasks and /api/v1/tasks-summary -> read backup-job history/cadence for operator attribution, read-only
vulnerabilities: CVE-2026-45695: unauthenticated RCE (CVSS 9.8) on POST /api/v1/repo/exists — SFTP storage-config fields passed unsanitized into an OpenSSH command line (naive space-split, no tokenizer/quote handling) enabling -oProxyCommand=<cmd> injection; exploitable only when server runs --without-password; affects <=0.22.3, fixed 0.23.0
